Zombies took the city at nine… and you're locked inside the old police station.
Sounds like the safest place in town… it isn't.
The radio says help arrives in seven days. Lights off. Gate locked. Open for no one.
Good news… you found the armory.
Bad news… one pistol. Fifteen bullets.
But bullets aren't what gets you first… water is. You need one gallon a day.
The water cooler has five… Four toilet tanks, that's six more, so eleven days. And help comes in seven.
And the front doors? Glass. So you never, ever go near the lobby.
You save your game. Day one… two forty-seven A.M.
At three fourteen, someone knocks on the glass.
Police department. We're evacuating the block. Open the door.
Then you check the duty log. Every officer on shift tonight… status: lost.
He's still knocking. Then every light in the station turns on… by itself.
Do you open the door? Comment yes or no… most comments decide Day two.
